description: This file defines an abstract base class for implementing protocol adapters within the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides core functionalities such as managing service clients, establishing connections, validating addresses, sending messages, and handling connection events. The class uses dependencies like Vert.x for asynchronous operations, Proton for AMQP messaging, and Spring for dependency injection. It serves as a foundational component for protocol-specific adapters that facilitate communication with devices and integration with Hono's services.

classes.name: AbstractProtocolAdapterBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational functionalities for protocol adapters in Hono, including connection management, message creation, address validation, and integration with Hono's services and health checks.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration object for this adapter.

methods.name: getTenantClient
methods.description: Provides a Future of the TenantClient to interact with tenant-specific APIs.

methods.name: getDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Provides a Future of the DeviceConnectionClient scoped to a specific tenant.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Initializes connections to dependent services; overridden by subclasses to perform startup routines.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Gracefully stops the adapter, disconnecting from services.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for service connections.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers health checks for liveness, such as event loop health.

methods.name: sendConnectedEvent
methods.description: Publishes a 'connected' event for a device.

methods.name: sendDisconnectedEvent
methods.description: Publishes a 'disconnected' event for a device.

methods.name: sendConnectedTtdEvent
methods.description: Publishes a TTD (time-to-disconnect) event indicating device is connected.

methods.name: sendDisconnectedTtdEvent
methods.description: Publishes a TTD event indicating device is disconnected.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Validates message target address for tenant consistency and device ownership.

methods.name: checkDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Checks whether a device is registered and active.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a new AMQP message with the appropriate Hono properties.

methods.name: addProperties
methods.description: Applies Hono-specific properties to an AMQP message.

methods.name: connectToService
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a specified Hono service component, with optional disconnect and reconnect handlers.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Performs comprehensive checks to determine if the adapter is connected to all necessary services.

methods.name: sendDisconnectedTtdEvent
methods.description: Sends a TTD event indicating the device is disconnected, with an optional active OpenTracing span for trace context.

methods.name: sendTtdEvent
methods.description: Sends a TTD (time-to-disconnect) event containing the device and tenant info, TTD, and trace context, performing necessary validation and upstream communication.

methods.name: isPayloadOfIndicatedType
methods.description: Validates that the payload body matches the indicated content type, specifically handling empty and non-empty notification types.

methods.name: onCloseCommandConsumer
methods.description: Optional handler called when a command consumer link is closed; default implementation logs closure, can be overridden.

methods.name: registerEventLoopBlockedCheck
methods.description: Registers a health check to verify if the Vert.x event loop is blocked, indicating potential health issues.

methods.name: getServerTrustOptions
methods.description: Provides trust options for server-side TLS configuration, defaulting to a validity-based trust if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getErrorCondition
methods.description: Creates an AMQP error condition from an exception, mapping specific ServiceInvocationExceptions to appropriate AMQP error conditions.

methods.name: getConnectionLimitManager
methods.description: Returns the current connection limit manager instance.

methods.name: setConnectionLimitManager
methods.description: Sets the connection limit manager to control service connection limits.
